newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia, Japan govts to postpone meeting.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia, Japan govts to postpone meeting.

text.p: Australian Foreign Affairs Minister Alexander Downer said on Thursday the Australian and Japanese governments would postpone the next regular meeting of senior ministers from both countries.
The meeting was to be held in Tokyo on November 11, Downer said in a statement.

"The two governments decided that, because of the delay in the formation of the new Japanese Cabinet, which now appears likely to be appointed only a few days before November 11, it would no longer be feasible to hold the meeting at that time," he said.
He said the governments would reschedule the meeting at a mutually convenient time in the near future.
The Australia-Japan Ministerial Committee has held alternate meetings in Australia and Japan on a regular basis since 1972.
